offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures motorized and towable recreational vehicles, including motorhomes, travel trailers, fifth wheels and camper vans. Sells mainly to independent dealers who sell to consumers, with production in North America and Europe.

primary_products.value: towable recreational vehicles; motorhomes; camper vans; recreational vehicle parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent recreational vehicle dealers in North America and Europe; B2C: individual RV owners buying via dealers, plus aftermarket parts

end_markets.value: recreational vehicles; outdoor leisure and travel

revenue_model.value: product sales: new RVs sold wholesale to dealers, aftermarket parts and accessories

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds RVs from purchased chassis, components and materials, sold to dealers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and Europe, mainly Germany, UK and France

specialization.value: related lines: towable RVs, motorhomes, camper vans and related parts across multiple brands

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent RV dealerships that sell to consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety, emissions and RV standards (NHTSA, EPA, RVIA, EU vehicle rules), state lemon laws
